rule: mix60c (Qwen3-30B-A3B): the continuation of mix60_s1_q30_s20261023 by the same method, each domain's selection continued in its own order past every row that list holds (main and buffer); no row of it comes back in the same domain except the science and function-calling rows below. Code 30 steps: infinibyte problems only, 70 % long / 30 % short by reference answer length (every hard original problem is already in mix60's list). Function calling 10 steps: first every long, deep row of mix60_s1_q30_s20261023's function-calling portion (prompt >= 16,000 tokens and >= 10 turns deep, the top length and depth bins of the list's selection), taken again in that list's order, then the Qwen3 function-calling list in its rank order past mix60's rows up to the portion's tokens; the portion in a seeded random order, the buffer the next rows of the list. No long context. Each domain is cut where it holds about the packed tokens of its steps for this model, estimated as for mix60_s1_q30_s20261023; the domains are interleaved so that every prefix holds the same fraction of each domain (row i of a domain with n rows at (i + 0.5) / n), then a 10 % buffer of further rows per domain.
